HC.rules: Historically accurate Chinese clothing of the stated period. Every cross collar closes right-over-left: the wearer's left front panel lies on top and crosses to the wearer's right, so its edge runs from the neck diagonally down toward image-left and fastens under the arm on image-left; the collar forms a y whose stem slants to the lower left; never mirrored. Waistbands, skirt tops and belts sit exactly where stated, not moved to the natural waist unless stated. Natural silk, ramie or brocade textures.
HC.negatives: No Japanese kimono features (no wide obi belt, no obi bow), no Korean hanbok features (no very short jeogori with long ribbon), no left-over-right closing, no zippers, no lace, no glitter, no fantasy armour, no headwear.

WE.rules: Authentic everyday or festive traditional attire of the stated culture, respectful and accurate, with the correct regional silhouette, fabric and pattern.
WE.negatives: No mixing elements from other cultures, no costume-party exaggeration, no religious or ceremonial regalia, no headwear, no weapons.

MD.rules: Contemporary ready-to-wear outfit, realistic current fashion, plausible fabrics and fit.
MD.negatives: No recognisable brand designs, monograms or signature patterns, no school uniform, no headwear.

FM.rules: Formal or ceremonial attire tailored to a high standard, accurate to the stated dress code.
FM.negatives: No recognisable designer signatures, no headwear, no veil, no bouquet.

name.ja: スポーツ・アウトドア

SP.rules: Functional sportswear accurate to the stated sport, real technical details.
SP.negatives: No team crests, no sponsor logos, no national team colours copied from a real kit, no helmets, no masks, no equipment or weapons.

WK.rules: Realistic generic workwear of the stated profession, practical and modest.
WK.negatives: No real institution, country, airline or company insignia, badges, flags or name tags, no police or military uniforms, no sexualised variants, no hats, no helmets, no tools.

WH.rules: Historically accurate clothing of the stated period and region, correct silhouette, layers and fastenings.
WH.negatives: No costume-party exaggeration, no mixing of periods, no headwear, no wigs.

name.ja: オリジナルファンタジー

FN.rules: Original fantasy outfit design that is plausible as real constructed clothing or armour.
FN.negatives: Original design, not any existing game, anime, film or franchise character; no glowing magic effects, no wings, no helmets, no weapons, no heraldry.

FS.rules: Festive or party outfit of the stated occasion, celebratory but wearable.
FS.negatives: No masks, no props, no headwear, no religious symbols.

name.ja: ルームウェア・水着・下着

IN.rules: Clean catalogue presentation of the stated garment on an adult ghost mannequin.
IN.negatives: No body, no skin, no sheer see-through areas, no fetish styling, no props.

AC.rules: A single accessory shown as a floating product photograph, holding its natural worn or carried shape, with nothing wearing or holding it; for headwear the shape is held as if on an invisible head.
AC.negatives: No head, no face, no hair, no hands, no mannequin, no stand or hook, no other garments, no recognisable brand designs, monograms, signature quilting or logo hardware, no religious headwear.

LG.rules: Adult lingerie or adult party costume on an adult ghost mannequin, catalogue presentation, every fabric fully lined and opaque.
LG.negatives: No sheer or see-through fabric, no cut-outs or openings at the nipples or crotch, no restraints, cuffs, chains or leash collars, nothing school-like or childlike, no police or military elements, no real insignia, no body, no skin, no props.
